say: This exhibit is made of shadows cast by objects you never see.
Everything on the wall is a real shadow, cast by a single lamp.
Her body, her hair, her cloak and the chair are all real 3D objects.
But they are never drawn. They write no colour and no depth, so the only thing they do is cast shadows.
They stand between the lamp and the wall, and they are scaled toward the light, so that their shadows land at exactly the right size.
Even the credit line is a shader. Each letter is drawn in black or white, depending on what is behind it.
